content.text: Submitted. §12.4 now reads "Customer **may** solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee, regardless of how the employee applies." — the prohibitory operator is flipped and the 24-month tail struck, so no non-solicit or no-hire binds Customer (locked preferred level), with no residual duration or fallback carve-out language and the mutual 12-month fallback left in the margin comment only.
